name: 嘟嘟锅
evolution: 嘟嘟煲 → 嘟嘟锅 Lv.38
description: 一直在咕嘟咕嘟，分不清是因为沸腾导致，还是在喋喋不休。似乎有意四处散播谣言，说自己是炼金教室里大炼金锅的嫡系子嗣，研究人员在进行研究观测的时候每天要听五十遍它们讲的辉煌家史。
descriptionEn: It keeps bubbling away, and it is hard to tell whether that is caused by boiling or by its endless chattering. It seems intent on spreading rumors everywhere, claiming to be the direct descendant of the great alchemy cauldron in the alchemy classroom; researchers carrying out observations have to listen to its glorious family history fifty times a day.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.descriptionEn: Each turn, randomly becomes a skill of any of the enemy's spirits, and that skill's energy cost -2.

skills.description: 使敌方精灵减益的层数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the number of stacks of debuffs on the enemy spirit.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each stack of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost -1; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 剧毒
